sentences.text: Agentic AI is beginning to reach core compliance work: Deutsche Bank has put agents into production on source-of-wealth checks in its private bank.
Most agentic pilots this fortnight were in payments: Danske Bank and Rogers Bank completed agent-initiated transactions with Mastercard, and GoCardless moved real money through an agent.
Among the large national banks, KB Kookmin Bank has taken a conversational assistant live for everyday banking, while Bank of Baroda's AI-powered app relaunch drew the widest coverage.
Supervisors are adopting AI in their own work: the Monetary Authority of Singapore is testing models to detect scam accounts, and the Bank of Thailand plans to audit lenders with it.
